subject: oakbranch
name: 橡树枝
label: 橡叶与橡果
learning: 先看大的轮廓，再挑一两处喜欢的地方画。
prompt:
Use case: original standalone picture-book illustration for Nilo children's drawing references. Make ONE square monochrome raster artwork, beautifully hand-drawn with confident dark charcoal-black contours, graceful proportions and clean open white spaces. White or genuinely transparent background, preserve ample clear margin all around, complete subject fully visible. No color fills, gray washes, shading, dense hatching, fine texture, logos, letters, numbers, border, collage, grid, watermark or instructional steps. Do not imitate a named artist. BEGINNER reference: a warm simple picture-book drawing, 3–5 large easy-to-read forms and a small number of necessary interior marks. Broad rounded organic silhouettes; no repetitive decoration. One short twig carrying a single broad lobed oak leaf and one large acorn.
Complete subject centered with generous 12% blank margins. Clean single contours and mostly empty interiors, no shading. An acorn cup is indicated by its boundary and at most three short curves, not a grid or scale texture. Only a few large leaf veins.
